import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int oo = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int maxN = 70;
    static final int maxn = 50;
    static final int lim = 22;

    static long C[][] = new long[maxN + 5][maxN + 5];

    static void prepare() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static int n, m, N;
    static int mid;
    static int g[] = new int[maxN + 5];
    static List<Pair> partb[][] = new ArrayList[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];

    static void dfs_partb(int x, int cnta, int cntb, long sum) {
        if (x == mid) {
            partb[cnta][cntb].add(new Pair(sum, 1));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            if (~g[x - 1] && i != g[x - 1]) continue;
            long tmp = 0;
            if (i == 0) {
                if (cnta > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta - 1, cntb, sum + tmp);
                }
            } else {
                if (cntb > 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][j] * C[N - x][n - j];
                    }
                    dfs_partb(x - 1, cnta, cntb - 1, sum + tmp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static Map<Long, Long> parta[][] = new HashMap[maxn + 5][maxn + 5];
    static long ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long ans_cnt = 0;

    static void update(long val, long cnt) {
        if (ans > val) {
            ans = val;
            ans_cnt = cnt;
        } else if (ans == val) {
            ans_cnt += cnt;
        }
    }

    static void bfs_parta() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                parta[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        parta[0][0].put(0L, 1L);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> u : parta[i][j].entrySet()) {
                    if (i + j == mid) {
                        int p = Collections.binarySearch(partb[i][j], new Pair(-u.getKey(), -1));
                        if (p < 0) p = -p - 1;
                        if (p < partb[i][j].size()) {
                            update(Math.abs(u.getKey() + partb[i][j].get(p).getKey()), u.getValue() * partb[i][j].get(p).getValue());
                        }
                        if (p > 0) {
                            update(Math.abs(u.getKey() + partb[i][j].get(p - 1).getKey()), u.getValue() * partb[i][j].get(p - 1).getValue());
                        }
                    } else {
                        int p = i + j;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
                            if (~g[p] && k != g[p]) continue;
                            int cnta = i, cntb = j;
                            if (k == 0) ++cnta;
                            else ++cntb;
                            if (cnta <= n + m && cntb <= n + m) {
                                long tmp = 0;
                                if (k == 0) {
                                    for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
                                        tmp += C[cnta - 1][n - 1] * C[cntb][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
                                        tmp -= C[cntb - 1][n - 1] * C[cnta][l] * C[N - p - 1][n - l];
                                    }
                                }
                                parta[cnta][cntb].put(u.getKey() + tmp, u.getValue());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void work() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                partb[i][j].clear();
            }
        }
        dfs_partb(N, n + m, n + m);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + m + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n + m + 1; j++) {
                Collections.sort(partb[i][j]);
                List<Pair> tmp = new ArrayList<>();
                int sz = partb[i][j].size();
                for (int k = 0; k < sz; ) {
                    long cur = partb[i][j].get(k).getKey();
                    int cnt = 0;
                    while (k < sz && partb[i][j].get(k).getKey() == cur) {
                        cnt += partb[i][j].get(k).getValue();
                        ++k;
                    }
                    tmp.add(new Pair(cur, cnt));
                }
                partb[i][j] = tmp;
            }
        }
        bfs_parta();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        prepare();
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        char[] s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        N = (n + m) << 1;
        mid = Math.max(0, N - lim);
        Arrays.fill(g, -1);
        work();
        ans_cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (s[i] == 'A') g[i] = 0;
            else if (s[i] == 'B') g[i] = 1;
        }
        work();
        pw.println(ans_cnt);
        pw.close();
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long key;
        int value;

        public Pair(long key, int value) {
            this.key = key;
            this.value = value;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return Long.compare(key, o.key);
        }
    }
